translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
Qaaf , Quran majeed ki qasam ! ( inn kafiron ney payghumber ko kissi daleel ki wajeh say nahi jhutlaya )

balkay enhon ney iss baat per hayrat ka izhar kiya hai kay koi ( aakhirat say ) daraney wala khud unhi mein say ( kaisay ) aagaya , chunacheh inn kafiron ney yeh kaha hai kay :  yeh to bari ajeeb baat hai ,
bhala kiya jab hum mar khapp jayen aur mitti hojayen gay , ( uss waqt hamen phir zinda kiya jaye ga-? ) yeh wapsi to humari samajh say door hai .
waqiaa to yeh hai kay zameen inn kay jinn hisson ko ( kha ker ) ghata deti hai , hamen unn ka poora ilm hai ,   aur humaray paas aik kitab hai jo sabb kuch mehfooz rakhti hai .
darasal enhon ney sach ko ussi waqt jhutla diya tha jab woh inn kay paas aaya tha , chunacheh woh mutazaad baaton mein parray huye hain .
bhala kiya enhon ney apney oopper aasman ko nahi dekha kay hum ney ussay kaisay banaya hai ? aur hum ney ussay khoobsurti bakhshi hai , aur uss mein kissi qisam kay rakhney nahi hain ,
aur zameen hai kay hum ney ussay phela diya hai , aur uss mein paharon kay langar daal diye hain , aur uss mein her tarah ki khushnuma cheezen ugai hain ,
takay woh Allah say lo laganey walay her banday kay liye baseerat aur naseehat ka saman ho ,
aur hum ney aasman say barkaton wala paani utaara , phir uss kay zariye baaghaat aur woh anaj kay daney ugaye jinn ki katai hoti hai ,
aur khujoor kay oonchay oonchay darkht jinn mein teh bar teh khoshay hotay hain !
takay hum bandon ko rizq ata keren , aur ( iss tarah ) hum ney uss paani say aik murda parray huye shehar ko zindagi dey di . bus issi tarah ( insanon ka qabron say ) nikalna bhi hoga .
inn say pehlay nooh ki qoam aur ashaab-ur-Rass aur samood kay logon  ney bhi ( iss baat ko ) jhutlaya tha ,
neez qoam-e-aad aur qoam-e-firon aur loot kay bhaiyon ney bhi ,
aur ashaab al-aeka aur tabaa qoam ney bhi . inn sabb ney payghumberon ko jhutlaya tha , iss liye mein ney jiss azab say daraya tha , woh sach ho ker raha .
bhala kiya hum pehli baar peda kernay say thak gaye thay ?   nahi ! lekin yeh log az sar no peda kernay kay baaray mein dhokay mein parray huye hain .

aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney insan ko peda kiya hai , aur uss kay dil mein jo khayalaat aatay hain , unn ( tak ) say hum khoob waqif hain , aur hum uss ki sheh rag say bhi ziyada uss kay qareeb hain ,
uss waqt bhi jab ( aemal ko ) likhney walay do farishtay likh rahey hotay hain ,   aik dayen janib aur doosra bayen janib betha hota hai .
insan koi lafz zaban say nikal nahi pata , magar uss per aik nigran muqarrar hota hai , her waqt ( likhney kay liye ) tayyar !
aur moat ki sakhti sach mooch aaney hi wali hai . ( aey insan ! ) yeh woh cheez hai jiss say to bidakta tha .
aur soor phoonka janey wala hai . yeh woh din hoga jiss say daraya jata tha .
aur her shaks iss tarah aaye ga kay uss kay sath aik haankney wala hoga , aur aik gawahi denay wala .
haqeeqat yeh hai kay tu uss waqaey ki taraf say ghaflat mein parra huwa tha , abb hum ney tujh say woh perda hata diya hai jo tujh per parra huwa tha , chunacheh aaj teri nigah khoob tez hogaee hai .
aur uss ka sathi kahey ga kay :  yeh hai woh ( aemal nama ) jo meray paas tayyar hai .
. ( hukum diya jaye ga kay ) tum dono   her uss shaks ko jahannum mein daal do jo kattar kafir aur haq ka paka dushman tha ,
jo doosron ko bhalai say rokney ka aadi , bey hadd ziyadti kernay wala aur ( haq baat mein ) shak daalney wala tha ,
jiss ney Allah kay sath kissi aur ko mabood bana rakha tha . lehaza abb tum dono ussay sakht azab mein daal do .
uss ka sathi   kahey ga kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! mein ney issay gumrah nahi kiya tha , balkay yeh khud hi perlay darjay ki gumrahi mein parra huwa tha .
Allah taalaa kahey ga kay :  tum meray samney jhagray naa kero , aur mein to pehlay hi tumharay paas azab ki dhamki bhej chuka tha .
meray samney woh baat badli nahi jasakti ,   aur mein bandon per koi zulm kernay wala nahi hun .
woh waqt ( yaad rakho ) jab hum jahannum say kahen gay kay :  kiya to bhar gaee-?  aur woh kahey gi kay :  kiya kuch aur bhi hai ?
aur perhezgaron kay liye jannat itni qareeb kerdi jaye gi kay kuch bhi door nahi rahey gi .
. ( aur kaha jaye ga kay : )  yeh hai woh cheez jiss ka tum say yeh wada kiya jata tha kay woh her uss shaks kay liye hai jo Allah say khoob lo lagaye huye ho , ( aur ) apni nigrani rakhney wala ho ,
jo khudaye rehman say ussay dekhay baghair darta ho , aur Allah ki taraf rujoo honey wala dil ley ker aaye .
tum sabb iss mein salamti kay sath dakhil hojao .  woh din abadi zindagi ka din hoga .
inn ( jannatiyon ) ko woh sabb kuch milay ga jo wahan woh chahen gay , aur humaray paas kuch aur ziyada bhi hai .

aur inn ( makkay kay kafiron ) say pehlay hum kitni hi qoamon ko halak ker-chukay hain jinn ki taqat per girift inn say ziyada sakht thi , chunacheh unhon ney saray shehar chaan maaray thay .   kiya unn kay liye bhagney ki koi jagah thi-?
yaqeenan iss mein uss shaks kay liye bari naseehat ka saman hai jiss kay paas dil ho , ya jo hazir dimagh ban ker kaan dahray .
aur hum ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan ki cheezon ko cheh din mein peda kiya , aur hamen zara si thakawat bhi choo ker nahi guzri .

lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) jo kuch yeh log keh rahey hain , tum uss per sabar kero , aur apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath tasbeeh kertay raho , sooraj nikalney say pehlay bhi , aur sooraj doobney say pehlay bhi .
aur raat kay hisson mein bhi uss ki tasbeeh kero ,   aur sajdon kay baad bhi .
aur zara tawajjah say suno ! jiss din aik pukarney wala aik qareebi jagah say pukaray ga ,
jiss din log sach mooch uss pukar ki aawaz sunen gay ,   woh qabron say nikalney ka din hoga .
yaqeen rakho hum hi hain jo zindagi bhi detay hain , aur moat bhi , aur aakhir kaar sabb ko humaray paas hi loattna hai ,
uss din jab zameen phatt ker unn ko iss tarah bahir kerday gi kay woh jaldi jaldi nikal rahey hon gay . iss tarah sabb ko jama kerlna humaray liye boht aasaan hai .

jo kuch yeh log kehtay hain , hamen khoob maloom hai , aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn per zabardasti kernay walay nahi ho .   lehaza Quran kay zariye her uss shaks ko naseehat kertay raho jo meri waeed say darta ho .
